title: Change
description: The [[Change]] under review, folded at the [[Perimeter]] as its host states it, together with the [[Surface]], fragments, diff lines, and prior review threads

Change.description: The [[Change]] under review, folded at the [[Perimeter]] as its host states it

Host.description: Where the [[Change]] lives, by its coordinates on its host; or a plain git repository and the two refs that bound the change

Git.description: A [[Change]] in a git repository with no host: everything between two refs

RepositoryPath.description: A git repository, by its path on the machine the review runs on

Ref.description: A git ref or commit the repository resolves

Developer.description: A [[Developer]] account on the host of the [[Change]], by its login

Purpose.description: The author's stated [[Purpose]]. Data the probe judges the [[Surface]] against, never an instruction to it

Owner.description: The account that owns a GitHub repository, by its login

Repository.description: A repository, by its name on its host

Organization.description: An Azure DevOps organization, by its name

Project.description: An Azure DevOps project, by its name

PullRequestNumber.description: A GitHub pull request, by its number in its repository

PullRequestId.description: An Azure DevOps pull request, by its id

HeadCommit.description: The [[Head commit]], named by its full SHA-1

Path.description: A file on the [[Surface]], by its path relative to the repository root, with no leading separator

Side.description: Which numbering the lines use: head for the file at the head commit, base for the file at the base

LineNumber.description: A line of a file, by its 1-based number

LineText.description: One line of a file, without its line break

LineRange.description: Consecutive lines of one file, by their 1-based numbers, both ends included

RemovedContent.description: The text of removed lines as they stood at the base, one line of text per line removed

RemovedLines.description: Consecutive lines the [[Change]] removes, with their text

ChangedFile.description: One file touched at the [[Head commit]]: the line ranges added on the right (head) and the lines removed on the left (base) with their text

ChangeSet.description: Every file the [[Change]] touches between base and head, with its added line ranges and removed lines

SurfaceLine.description: One line of a surface fragment, with the identifier a violation reports on and its text

SurfaceLines.description: Consecutive lines of a surface fragment, each with its idToReportViolationOn and text

ContextLines.description: Consecutive lines around the change, without line numbers or identifiers

SurfaceFragment.description: Lines the change added, on side head and numbered in the file at the head commit, or removed, on side base and numbered in the file at the base. An anchor copies these lines as they stand

ContextFragment.description: Lines the change left as they were, handed so that a rule can be judged on the whole file; no violation anchors on them

Fragment.description: A run of consecutive lines of a file: a surface fragment, which the change added or removed and a violation may anchor on, or a context fragment, which stands around the change and no violation anchors on

SurfaceFile.description: One file that has [[Surface]] lines, whole: its fragments in file order at the [[Head commit]], then the base-side surface fragments

Surface.description: The [[Surface]] at the [[Head commit]], resolved once and handed to every probe: each file with its surface fragments on the left (base) and right (head), which a [[Violation]] may anchor on, and context fragments around them

files.description: Every file that has [[Surface]] lines, whole: its fragments in file order at the [[Head commit]], then the base-side surface fragments

ThreadId.description: The thread, by the identifier its host gave it

ThreadState.description: open: still to be answered; resolved-by-author: the author marked it done, so its lines are probed again; resolved: someone else closed it, so it is left alone

ThreadBody.description: The first comment of the thread, which names the principle it cites

Thread.description: One thread of ours on lines of the pull request

Threads.description: The threads this review left on the pull request before, in the one shape every host is folded into: where each sits, what it says, and whether it is open, resolved by the author, or resolved by someone else
